reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and the "Every batch lab-tested" line, which is nice, but I already have a magnesium that works and it comes on Subscribe & Save from a brand I trust. A new brand with zero reviews is not something I swap in for what I take every day.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A lab report the brand picked itself is not the same as a third-party certification I already trust, and I would not risk my routine on an unknown.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box plus a few hundred real reviews, or a sample size that costs a few dollars so I can try it without committing.
